rationale: The theft falls inside the covered trip and was reported to the Carabinieri within 24 hours, so section 5 of the wording and the police report condition are met, and the snatch from your arm is not "unattended" (manual s.7). One required document is missing: under manual s.5, proof of value is needed for the leather jacket claimed at $420, and a cash purchase with no receipt is not proof. Please send a purchase receipt, card statement or receipt for a replacement jacket; the claim stays open for 30 days, and if it is supplied the payout would be $330 ($300 jacket per-item limit + $80 daypack, less the $50 Premium deductible) for a claims handler to review.
